outcome: Interval of dilatation stopping to delivery
Duration of first and second stages of labor
cohort: 142 primiparous pregnant women referred to Jiroft University hospitals who had stagnation during labor
finding: Oral sodium bicarbonate solution, in addition to oxytocin, significantly reduced the interval of dilatation stopping to delivery and the duration of the first and second stages of labor in primiparous women with labor stagnation compared to oxytocin alone.
mod_finding: The rate of spontaneous delivery was significantly higher in the group that received oral bicarbonate solution.
